identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC policy] Permit audited gh break-glass during confirmed typed regressions

review_prompts: Can the exception be invoked without a reproducible typed-owner regression and exact explicit operator authorization?
Does any wording permit merge, close, finish, cleanup, deletion, force, secret, workflow, release, administrative, or bulk operations?
Do receipts establish exact local and remote identity without retaining secrets or sensitive bodies?
Is every later lifecycle claim frozen until typed reconciliation succeeds?
residual_risk: Hosted CI, publication, merge, typed finish, and post-merge cleanup remain required before the policy is terminal or usable.
